title: Leipzig 32% over emission budget
description: The gas-fired paint oven was due to be replaced in April and slipped to December. Leipzig alone explains the whole group overshoot.

title: Renewable share below 75% target
description: Group share is 68.6%. Brno still buys grey electricity until its power purchase agreement starts in November.

title: Forklift delivery at risk
description: Only 6 of 24 electric forklifts delivered to Valencia DC. Diesel units still in use.

title: Hamburg solar plant live
description: The 2.1 MWp rooftop installation has been running since July and lifted Hamburg's renewable share to 88%.
